title: Reasons for Sharp Increase in Popping Floor Tiles at Some HDB Flats
what_it_is: Reasons for Sharp Increase in Popping Floor Tiles at Some HDB Flats

sections.label: Causes of dislodged HDB floor tiles
sections.summary: The Minister states causes of dislodged floor tiles include thermal expansion, deterioration of the tile-screed bond, and unusually cold weather in January 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development what are the causes of the recent sharp rises in the popping and cracking of floor tiles at some HDB flats and how does HDB assist residents faced with such situations.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: They may dislodge due to various reasons, such as differential thermal expansion and contraction of tiles, or the natural deterioration of the bond between the tiles and the screed surface.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: All these can cause a loss of adhesion between the tiles and the screed surface, and the dislodgement of tiles.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We have observed a higher number of reported dislodged tiles cases in the first half of January 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: This was likely due to the unusually cold weather over a prolonged period and temperature fluctuations.

sections.label: Owner-installed tiles in HDB flats
sections.summary: Close to half of reported HDB flat cases involved tiles installed by flat owners during their own renovations.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Among the cases reported in Housing and Development Board (HDB) flats, close to half involved tiles installed by the flat owners during their own renovations.

sections.label: HDB goodwill tile repair assistance
sections.summary: HDB offers goodwill repairs for dislodged tiles up to 15 years, and beyond that helps with removal, disposal and protective sheets.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Besides helping flat owners repair dislodged tiles originally provided by HDB during the one-year DLP, it also offers goodwill repairs for such dislodged tiles for up to 15 years.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For cases beyond 15 years, flat owners will need to do their own replacement of tiles.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Nonetheless, HDB will do its best to assist, for example, by helping the owners with the removal and disposal of the affected tiles and, if necessary, laying protective sheets over the affected areas.

sections.label: Request to extend goodwill repair
sections.summary: A member asks whether HDB would extend goodwill repair beyond 15 years, and notes repair costs range from $5,000 to $10,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Therefore, if that is the case, would HDB be flexible to extend that goodwill repair to those cases, even though it is after 15 years?

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: And the next shocking truth is, of course, to know the costs of repair, which can range from $5,000 to $10,000.
